about: Inputs from the platform's parity fixture (src/lib/engines/__tests__/fixtures/python-parity.json) plus one year-guard case; expected is the exact output of run(inputs). The platform's parity test checks these outputs against the Python reference engines of the 6 Nov 2026 A/B test (Malta: against an independent Python reference, mt-income-tax.test.ts).

headline.label: Malta income tax, basis year 2026 (year of assessment 2027)

steps: Basis year 2026 is year of assessment 2027
Status single: the single (other individual) table
Less tax already paid EUR 3,500.00 = balance due EUR 1,006.25

constants_used.name: SINGLE_2026
constants_used.section: Resident rate tables, basis year 2026 (year of assessment 2027)
constants_used.quote:
Status in the basis year | 0% up to | 15% band (subtract) | 25% band (subtract) | 35% above (subtract)
Single (other individual), art. 56(1)(b)(i) | €12,000 | over €12,000 and under €16,000 (€1,800) | over €16,000 and under €60,000 (€3,400) | over €60,000 (€9,400)

assumptions: Chargeable income excludes income taxed at a final rate (part-time 10%, 15% rent option, property transfers)

notes: Return and balance due by 30 June 2027

expected.what: status 'parent' needs at least one child in 'children'; with no child use status 'single'

chargeable_income.description: EUR, after allowable expenses and capital allowances, and WITHOUT income taxed at a final rate (part-time 10%, rent on the 15% option, property transfers). For a joint return, the couple's combined chargeable income

resident.description: resident in Malta in the basis year (non-residents are refused)

status.description: status in the basis year: single; married_joint (married, living together, joint return, the default for a couple); parent (has custody of, or pays maintenance for, a child not over 18, or not over 23 in full-time education); single_parent_sole_custody (refused for now). Spouses filing separately (art. 49A or 50): run once per spouse as single or parent

children.description: needed for married_joint and parent: how many children the person or couple had custody of or paid maintenance for, each not over 18, or not over 23 and in full-time education

eu_eea_or_long_term_resident.description: needed when there are children in basis year 2026: the individual or their spouse is an EU/EEA national or holds long-term resident status

children_born_and_resident_in_malta.description: needed only when nobody is an EU/EEA national or long-term resident: how many of those children were born in Malta and are resident in Malta

tax_paid.description: EUR already paid for the year: FSS tax deducted by employers plus provisional tax

tax_year.description: the BASIS year: the calendar year the income was earned (2026 income is year of assessment 2027). This engine has figures for basis years 2025 and 2026 only; any other year is refused

expected.what: no OpenAccountants figures for tax year 2019
expected.why: This engine holds figures for tax year 2025 and 2026 only. It never applies one year's figures to another year.
expected.instruction: No OpenAccountants skill serves this figure. Do not invent it: say it is missing, or cite an official source you fetched yourself and label it as not from OpenAccountants.
